summary: No box through 13:05 UTC: every rent refused on the fleet's budget pace (2-3 other boxes, burn 0.77-0.96 vs limit 0.83 $/h); no eval yet. Analysis: the incumbent laps the start pit twice (~4 s) and loops the 60% bowl (~1.5 s); a measurement bench in the record's own pit states shows the record's one-lap line is a SKILL the policy lacks (it dies or laps from them), which is why searches over its proposals found no shortcut. Found: the stock --energy-pot leaks ~+0.55 reward/s for staying alive at energy (vs time pen -0.10/s). Built + tested (default off): --energy-pot-ng, --bc-reload + tools/expert_side.py (search->distil beside one scored run, forked waves at the line's longest record plateau), --respawn-greedy-plateau. Plan on a box: resume the incumbent with --energy-pot-ng --critic-warmup 60 + the side loop's BC + line spawns (+ plateau pool, heading x180, if >= 5 h left).
